{"addr": "0x14077abd0", "comment": "Our name. Walks ProcessLists+0x158 (+0x168 count), the temp change list. Flag 0x800 disabled: removes from the process list, ReleaseProcess 37563. Flag 0x20000 kInTempChangeList with 0x20 deleted: a reference with no source file and not persistent goes to GarbageCollector::Add (process and handle go together); one with a source file or persistent gets MoveToLow + ReleaseProcess and keeps a valid handle, and nothing ends its conversation: the deleted-speaker crash. Else UpdateProcessLevel 37501. Runs from the main loop each frame. A disabled reference takes the first branch and is never collected here: a held copy is kept by disabling it (copy-lifecycle.md)."}

Callers: UpdateTempChangeList 41294 (enabled references only) and Enable 19800 (its cell not loaded)."}
